description.fun: By day Oddish buries itself in the ground with only its leaves showing, and yanking on them makes it let out a horrible shriek, a nod to the mandrake root of legend. At night it uproots itself and wanders up to 300 metres, scattering seeds and looking for rich soil. It's one of only two Pokémon with a scientific name: Oddium wanderus.
description.guide: A small, blue Grass and Poison Pokémon resembling a root vegetable with five leaves on its head. It hides buried in the ground by day and wanders at night, absorbing moonlight to grow. It evolves into Gloom.
description.tagline: A walking weed that screams if you pull its leaves

description.fun: Gloom's drool is actually sticky nectar, and together with its flower it gives off a stench that can make people faint more than 1.6 km away. A very few people love the smell, though, and it's a key ingredient in some perfumes. The good news: it only reeks when it feels in danger. Its Japanese name, Kusaihana, simply means 'stinking flower'.
description.guide: The middle stage of Oddish's line, a Grass and Poison Pokémon with a large flower on its head. It drips sticky nectar and gives off a foul odour that grows worse when it is threatened. It evolves into Vileplume with a Leaf Stone or into Bellossom with a Sun Stone.
description.tagline: A drooling flower whose smell can knock you out a mile away

branches.text: Gloom's future depends on the stone it's given: a Leaf Stone grows its flower into Vileplume's giant petals, while a Sun Stone turns it into Bellossom, a dancing Grass-only Pokémon added in Generation 2. Bellossom is the only single-type Pokémon that evolves from a dual-type one.

description.fun: Vileplume carries what are said to be the largest petals in the world, so heavy it can barely hold them up. It flaps them or bursts into bloom with a bang to release clouds of toxic pollen that paralyse its prey, which is why the Pokédex warns never to go near pretty flowers in the jungle. It's modelled on Rafflesia arnoldii, the plant with the largest single flower on Earth.
description.guide: One of Oddish's two final forms, evolving from Gloom with a Leaf Stone. It is a Grass and Poison Pokémon with a huge red flower on its head that releases toxic, allergenic pollen to paralyse prey. Its design is based on the Rafflesia flower.
description.tagline: The world's largest petals, loaded with paralysing pollen

description.fun: Bellossom is a little hula dancer, with a leafy skirt and flowers in its hair. It dances when cloudy days drag on or when the rainy season ends and the sun comes out, and rubbing its petals together makes a pleasing chime. Strangely, the worse its Gloom smelled, the more beautiful Bellossom's petals turn out.
description.guide: One of Oddish's two final forms, introduced in Generation 2 and evolving from Gloom with a Sun Stone. It is a Grass Pokémon resembling a hula dancer, with flowers on its head and a skirt of leaves, and it is often seen dancing in the sun.
description.tagline: A sunny hula dancer that used to be a stinky Gloom
